author_claim: In normal cyclical account circulating-money change is effect of credit change; common gold-linked units can move together.
author_internal_qualification: 377–380: bank institutions transmit/control fluctuations but their existence, joint functions or short lending are not alone the root; merchant/promoter forecasts and balance reallocations matter.
normative_target_choice: 374–375: final-consumption index, consumer outlay adjusted for population/work quality, and deferred-consumption justice are distinct alternatives, not a finished numerical control algorithm.
independent_boundary: Counterfactual is theory, not natural experiment; do not generalize cash-as-effect to all fiscal/war/legal supply shocks.
